text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During lunch today, Air Groove comes over to ask Mejiro Dober about essential oils.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: For headaches, lavender and bergamot are best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, I recommend you use them with a clay mask before bed. It'll help you relax.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A clay mask… Thanks. I'll give it a try. You're even more knowledgeable than I heard you were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who did you hear about me from?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Me, of course! I went an' told everyone how smart you are, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Taiki?! But it's not as if I know that much about essential oils…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Don't be so modest! You know everythin' from beauty care to healthy habits, study hacks, and even sleeping tips!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Everyone needs to know how much learnin' ya got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I mean, it makes me happy to hear you say that, but…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… Excuse me? Dober, you know a lot about essential oils, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I know a little. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm actually asking on Spe's behalf. Her poor stomach is always growling, and I was wondering if there are oils that suppress hunger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Suppress hunger? I've heard of ones that boost appetite, but let's see… I suppose something minty would help…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following this, countless students start consulting Mejiro Dober about their troubles.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I never seem to get enough sleep. Are there any essential oils that promote better sleep or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Settle down, you two. You should both use some geranium oil to help calm your nerves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: For muscle pain, I recommend using a beeswax cream mixed with lavender and tea tree oil.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Beeswax? Ooh, I wonder if the wax will have any honey left on it? Sounds delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It won't, so don't try to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After having to deal with an endless stream of queries, Mejiro Dober is exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whew… I can finally take a break…
